name: 系带深领修身打底衫款

category.leaf: 系带深领修身五分袖T恤

description: 深领口系带设计，后背交叉镂空，纯色修身打底T恤

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, warm light-grey studio backdrop #EDEDEB for info shots, soft beige board #F5F1E8 for detail shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft neutral studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless backdrop paper and smooth matte board, natural wooden hangers as the presentation anchor
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular icon slots, single neutral color, kept empty unless copy is supplied
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front-facing and slight 3/4 hero presentation with the garment on a wooden hanger; flat lay only for spec screens; consistent garment scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean minimal womenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm light-grey backdrop #EDEDEB, soft beige board #F5F1E8, deep charcoal garment tone #1E1E1E, deep grey text #2D2D2D and one terracotta accent #C97B4A; soft neutral studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line circular icon style; clean high-end garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable front-facing and slight 3/4 hero presentation on natural wooden hangers; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首屏干净合规，正面版型一眼看清
shots.camera: straight-on at eye level, garment centered on a natural wooden hanger, full front silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment hangs centered on a natural wooden hanger, photographed straight-on at eye level with the full front silhouette visible and nothing cropped. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the hem. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margins, no extra whitespace reserved for copy. 8K commercial womenswear quality. Negative: no model, no mannequin head, no brand label, no watermark, no extra text, no background tint, no cut-off sleeves or hem, no floating without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达深领口系带与后背交叉的差异化设计
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle with close-up framing on the bodice, garment on a wooden hanger positioned on the left of the frame
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light with gentle fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment on a wooden hanger positioned on the left of the frame, photographed at a slight 3/4 angle with close-up framing from the shoulder to the waist so the deep lace-up neckline reads clearly. Soft front-left key light with gentle fill, soft contact shadow. Warm light-grey studio backdrop #EDEDEB. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space across the right 35% kept as clean backdrop with no text rendered. Negative: no dense body text, no invented fabric claims, no brand marks, no watermark, no props covering the garment, no more than one visual claim.

shots.intent: 街拍场景代入，展示后背交叉镂空的实穿效果
shots.camera: photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, generic adult model framed from shoulders to hips, no face in frame
shots.lighting: soft natural daylight from the left at 5500K, gentle directional shadows
shots.background: quiet urban street wall in muted grey-green #B7BDB4
shots.props: a light shoulder bag worn away from the garment
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle street scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A generic adult model framed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, shoulders to hips visible, showing the criss-cross open-back construction of the garment. Soft natural daylight from the left at 5500K, gentle directional shadows. A quiet urban street wall in muted grey-green #B7BDB4 as the background. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, a modest clean margin above the head, no extra whitespace reserved for copy. Negative: no recognizable face, no third-party brand marks or trademark graphics, no distorted hands or fingers, no watermark, no extra text, no cluttered street props.

shots.intent: 微距证明面料肌理与系带做工，支撑品质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the lace-up neckline, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft directional side light with a controlled highlight revealing knit texture
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the lace-up neckline and the fine knit surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed as a macro detail with shallow depth of field, foreground sharp. Soft directional side light with a controlled highlight revealing the knit texture and the braid of the tie. Soft beige board background #F5F1E8. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace since the texture is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no frayed threads or pilling, no invented fabric composition labels, no extra text, no watermark, no hands.

shots.intent: 对比普通领口松垮变形，突出本品领口服帖耐看
shots.camera: two matched close-up panels of the neckline region, identical straight-on eye-level framing and identical lighting on both sides
shots.lighting: soft even studio light, identical on both panels
shots.background: light grey backdrop #EDEDEB on both panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison layout for {product}, two matched close-up panels of the neckline region with identical straight-on eye-level framing and identical lighting. Left panel: a generic plain tee whose neckline gapes and waves loosely. Right panel: {product} with the neckline sitting smooth and flat and a clean shoulder line. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Light grey backdrop #EDEDEB on both panels, soft even light. Each garment occupies 50-60% of its panel, no whitespace reserved for copy. Negative: no fabricated test data or statistics, no brand marks on either panel, no mismatched lighting between panels, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 平铺尺码信息图消除合身疑虑，参数留白待填
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, garment laid flat and symmetric
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: an empty spec card on the right with blank cells and an empty size table
shots.whitespace: clean margin around the flat lay, right 45% reserved for the empty spec card
shots.textZone: empty spec card on the right 45%
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec screen of {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the garment laid flat and symmetric. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. Pure white table surface #FFFFFF. On the right an empty spec card with blank cells labeled 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 and an empty size table containing no measured numbers. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame, a clean margin around the flat lay with the right 45% reserved for the empty spec card. Negative: no invented measurements or size numbers, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no skewed garment edges.

shots.intent: 车线做工细节与空白图标位降低购买顾虑
shots.camera: tight close-up on the shoulder seam stitching, seam line crossing the frame diagonally
shots.lighting: soft diffused light from the upper left with a controlled highlight on the stitch line
shots.props: four empty thin-line circular icon slots along the bottom, no text inside
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}, tight close-up on the shoulder seam stitching with the seam line crossing the frame diagonally. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft diffused light from the upper left with a controlled highlight on the stitch line. Light grey backdrop #EDEDEB. Along the bottom four empty thin-line circular icon slots with no text inside. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, no extra whitespace reserved for copy. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, quality grades, antibacterial rates or test data, no badge artwork, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 双色选择收口促单，顶部预留标题位引导行动
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, two colorways of the same garment side by side on wooden hangers at identical height
shots.lighting: even soft studio light with soft contact shadows, identical across both colorways
shots.props: one thin terracotta accent line {accent_color} under the top margin
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 20% reserved for a short closing headline, no text rendered
shots.promptTemplate: Closing promo shot of {product}, two colorways of the same garment side by side on wooden hangers at a slight 3/4 angle, identical height and identical lighting across both. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows. Soft beige panel background #F5F1E8 with one thin terracotta accent line {accent_color} under the top margin. The pair occupies 55-65% of the frame overall, generous negative space across the top 20% reserved for a short closing headline with no text rendered. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no price numbers, no lighting drift between the two colorways, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1为浅灰底木衣架正面挂拍与标题区块、基本信息卡（品名写作连衣裙、颜色黑白、尺码S-XL、弹力/版型/柔软/厚度四条指数条）；屏2为洗涤图标、尺码表（肩宽35-41、胸围78-106、适配体重85-150斤）与适用场合文案及挂拍；屏3品名写作V领系带T恤并配明星街拍双图与黑色面料微距；屏4为缝纫车线工艺图、四个圆形卖点图标与正反面挂拍；屏5为商品特色与四大优点列表及领口圆形细节；屏6为领口系带微距、袖口卷边微距与腰部版型说明，屏5/屏6带重复英文字母水印。品类判定：源夹名「童装」有误——尺码表肩宽35-41cm、胸围78-106cm、适配体重85-150斤为成年女码量级，屏3/屏5品名均为T恤/打底衫且画面为成人成衣，判定为女装/上衣；屏1「连衣裙」与屏3「T恤」自相矛盾，均不作为事实采信，按画面成衣形态（套头衫）归入上衣。已剥离：重复字母水印、明星街拍人像与面容、原品牌标题区块、成分含量数值、尺码表实测数值、四条指数条取值、透气/亲肤/质感/色牢度图标文案、洗涤图标、四大优点原文案；原文数值一律改为{callout_n}或空白proof占位，产品一律以{product}占位。
